Seedot

Grass

Hoenn · Generation 3

Seedot is a Grass-type Acorn Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 0.5 m tall and weighs 4 kg. It evolves into Nuzleaf. Its highest base stat is Defense (50), with a base stat total of 220.
